claim.statement: Logs can be exported on a schedule as Parquet to a local path, file://, s3:// or gs://, metrics can be archived to an S3 bucket prefix, and council state and volume snapshots can be shipped to object storage; these are the documented off-node data interfaces.
claim.measurable: Configure each key against a MinIO or GCS bucket; Parquet log files appear within export_interval_secs (default 3600); the checkpoint prevents repeat exports; metrics chunks appear under a per-node prefix and the bucket lifecycle (not bun) handles retention; council backup objects appear every interval_secs (300) and retain = 24 are kept. Credentials come from each backend's standard environment variables.
